source_term: set

source_term: element/member of a set
telugu: మూలకం
basis: TE-P008 explicitly uses element in membership/inclusion sense; original draft choice confirmed by later native evidence.
uncertainty: Low for membership noun; synonym is editorial
macro: Preserve !!{element}, !!a{element} and plural identifiers; localize visible inflections in renderer

source_term: extensionality
telugu: మూలకాధారిత సమానత్వం
basis: Describes exactly the English membership criterion. AP uniqueness/order discussion informs native exposition only, not technical-sense attestation.
borrowing: No disguised English transliteration; English source-term retained in terminology index

source_term: subset / proper subset
telugu: ఉపసమితి / నిజ ఉపసమితి
basis: Subset directly attested; proper subset witness uses క్రమ ఉపసమితి. Retain descriptive నిజ ఉపసమితి as explicit editorial variant with identical strict inclusion definition.
uncertainty: Low for subset; medium for selected proper-subset variant

source_term: power set
telugu: ఘాత సమితి
basis: Native question explicitly names and enumerates the power set; confirms the draft term.

source_term: proof / theorem
telugu: నిరూపణ / సిద్ధాంతం
scope: Mathematical proof and theorem, not every derivability sense

source_term: logic
telugu: తర్కం
scope: Logic supporting mathematical reasoning; later formal logics need concept-specific decisions

source_term: natural number / integer / positive integer
telugu: సహజ సంఖ్య / పూర్ణ సంఖ్య / ధన పూర్ణ సంఖ్య
decision: Use spaced forms consistently. Preserve OpenLogic Nat={0,1,2,...}; no witness-driven change to the set. Fresh current-edition integer definition confirms the selected label; recovered older binary remains absent.

source_term: empty set / union / intersection / difference / disjoint
telugu: శూన్య సమితి / సమ్మేళనం / ఛేదనం / భేదం / వియుక్త
basis: Union/intersection and disjointness terms confirmed. Empty-set/difference choices remain descriptive unless separately passage-indexed.

source_term: rational / irrational / real number
telugu: కరణీయ సంఖ్య / అకరణీయ సంఖ్య / వాస్తవ సంఖ్య
scope: Number-class usage in mathematical pedagogy; preserve original mathematical sets

source_term: finite / infinite / string / sequence / alphabet
telugu: పరిమిత / అనంత (witness synonym అపరిమిత) / సంకేతమాల / క్రమం / వర్ణమాల
basis: TE-P016 directly contrasts పరిమిత and అపరిమిత sets through countability of their elements. The established edition wording అనంత is retained as a transparent synonym for consistency. String, sequence and alphabet remain definition-controlled provisional senses.
uncertainty: Low for finite/infinite concepts; medium-high for formal-language terminology

source_term: ordered pair / tuple / Cartesian product
telugu: క్రమిత జత / క్రమిత బహుళకం / కార్టీజియన్ లబ్ధం
basis: Witness uses native ordered-pair term క్రమయుగ్మం and a Telugu rendering of Cartesian product. Retain descriptive క్రమిత జత with witness synonym documented; tuple generalization remains provisional. Cartesian is a source-eponym borrowing.

source_term: Russell's paradox / contradiction / comprehension / axiom
telugu: రసెల్ వైరుధ్యం / విరోధం / ధర్మసంగ్రహం / స్వీకృతం
basis: Russell is an explicit source-eponym borrowing. Descriptive comprehension term and axiom choice are provisional; inspected logic/proof pages support register only.
uncertainty: High nomenclatural; keep existence-versus-uniqueness and reductio content fixed

source_term: perfect number / proper divisor / continuum / induction / recursive
telugu: పరిపూర్ణ సంఖ్య / నిజ భాజకం / అవిచ్ఛిన్న సమితి / ఆగమనం / పునరావృత్త
basis: Induction appears broadly in teacher pedagogy, not yet formal induction theorem. Other exact senses not directly attested; source definitions and examples preserved.
uncertainty: Medium-high; native specialist canon expansion remains required

source_term: binary relation / domain / range / function / inverse / composition
telugu: ద్విస్థానిక సంబంధం / ప్రవేశం / వ్యాప్తి / ప్రమేయం / విలోమం / సంయుక్తం
basis: Relation as pair set and function examples actually inspected. Binary modifier is descriptive; distinguish a relation on A from a relation between A and B.

source_term: reflexive / transitive / symmetric / antisymmetric / irreflexive / asymmetric / connected
telugu: స్వావర్తన / సంక్రామక / సౌష్ఠవ / ప్రతిసౌష్ఠవ / అస్వావర్తన / ఏకదిశ / సంయుక్త
basis: Native relation examples and proof register support exposition but do not attest these property names. Definitions control each sense. అస్వావర్తన means every diagonal pair absent, not merely failure of reflexivity; ఏకదిశ means no pair in both directions, not merely nonsymmetry. సంయుక్త means comparison of every distinct pair, not graph connectedness.

source_term: identity / equivalence relation / equivalence class / quotient / preorder / partial order / linear order / strict order
telugu: తాదాత్మ్య / తుల్యతా సంబంధం / తుల్యతా వర్గం / వర్గీకృత సమితి / పూర్వక్రమం / పాక్షిక క్రమం / రేఖీయ క్రమం / కఠిన క్రమం
basis: Relation and proof native registers only. Definitions, partition proof and strict-versus-nonstrict construction fixed by OpenLogic. Quotient is explicitly the set of equivalence classes, not a subset.

source_term: predicate / proposition / singular term / set-theoretic reductionism / metaphysical identity
telugu: విధేయం / ప్రవచనం / ఏకవస్తు పదం / సమితి-సిద్ధాంత సంక్షేపణవాదం / అధిభౌతిక తాదాత్మ్యం
basis: Native statement and reasoning register only. Predicate-name distinction, nonuniqueness argument and metaphysical caveats translated from OpenLogic. Historical names transliterated from source.

source_term: graph / vertex / edge / tree / root / branch / well-order / successor / predecessor
telugu: గ్రాఫు / శీర్షం / అంచు / వృక్షం / వృక్షమూలం / శాఖ / సుక్రమం / ఉత్తరవర్తి / పూర్వవర్తి
basis: Graph and node are explicit English borrowings. Other terms are descriptive choices anchored in source definitions. These native relation/proof pages do not attest the formal graph/tree senses. König is a source eponym.

source_term: formula / derivation / propositional logic / first-order logic / completeness / computability
telugu: సూత్రం / నిష్పాదన / ప్రవచన తర్కం / ప్రథమక్రమ తర్కం / సంపూర్ణత / గణనీయత
basis: General statement/proof evidence, not precise metatheory. Original formula and derivation token identities preserved for inflected rendering.

source_term: closure / restriction / relational image / relative product
telugu: సంవృతం / పరిమితం చేసిన సంబంధం / వర్తింపజేసిన ఫలితం / సాపేక్ష లబ్ధం
basis: Relation and inverse/composition register only, not attestation of all exact operator senses. Preserve argument order, positive-power indexing and identity inclusion.

source_term: codomain / mapping / argument / value
telugu: సహప్రవేశం / ప్రతిచిత్రణం / ఆర్గ్యుమెంట్ / విలువ
basis: Codomain is directly named separately from domain and range. Mapping/value are descriptive register choices. Argument and input are explicit English borrowings, not claimed native technical attestations.

source_term: injective / surjective / bijective; injection / surjection / bijection
telugu: ఒకటి-ఒకటి / సంగ్రస్త / ద్విగుణ; corresponding ప్రమేయం nouns
basis: Surjective and bijective labels directly inspected. One-to-one is the selected transparent Telugu variant for the injective condition rather than a claim that the witness prints this exact headword. Source at-most-one, at-least-one and combined conditions control meaning.
uncertainty: Medium for nomenclature; grammatical realization of article/capitalization/plural tokens belongs to the reader, which is not built yet.

source_term: partial / total / defined / undefined / well-defined / serial / left inverse / right inverse / Axiom of Choice
telugu: పాక్షిక / సర్వత్ర నిర్వచిత / నిర్వచిత / అనిర్వచిత / సునిర్వచిత / సీరియల్ / ఎడమ విలోమం / కుడి విలోమం / ఎంపిక స్వీకృతం
basis: Function uniqueness/totality and inverse register support explanation, not attestation of all these names. Serial is an explicit English borrowing with forall-input/exists-value definition. Choice footnote and empty-domain source caveat remain visible.

source_term: constant function / identity function
telugu: స్థిర ప్రమేయం / తాదాత్మ్య ప్రమేయం
basis: Native witness uses స్థిర and తత్సమ. Retain the prior తాదాత్మ్య terminology choice for identity with the same f(x)=x definition; do not claim this selected identity headword occurs on the inspected page.

source_term: enumeration / enumerable / nonenumerable / countability
telugu: లెక్కింపు / లెక్కించదగిన / లెక్కించలేని / లెక్కించదగినతనం
basis: TE-P016 supplies native mathematical counting language only for finite versus infinite sets. The selected forms transparently extend that register, but every occurrence is governed by OpenLogic's precise list, surjection or bijection definition, so finite countability is not conflated with enumerability.
alternatives: గణనీయ/అగణనీయ was rejected here to avoid collision with the edition's provisional computability term గణనీయత; జాబితా చేయదగిన remains an explanatory gloss.
uncertainty: Medium nomenclatural; definitions and formulas exact

source_term: equinumerous / equinumerosity / cardinality / no larger than / smaller than
telugu: సమసంఖ్యాక / సమసంఖ్యాకత / సమితి పరిమాణం / పరిమాణంలో మించని / పరిమాణంలో చిన్నది
basis: TE-P016 and TE-P017 directly distinguish equal-member-count sets from literal set equality in finite examples. సమసంఖ్యాక is selected as a transparent headword to avoid collision with the established equivalence-relation terminology; OpenLogic's bijection and injection definitions control the extension to infinite sets.
uncertainty: Low for finite concept, medium for selected headword and infinite extension

source_term: Cantor zig-zag / pairing function / encode / code / diagonal method / diagonalization / reduction / Schröder-Bernstein
telugu: కాంటర్ జిగ్‌జాగ్ పద్ధతి / జతీకరణ ప్రమేయం / సంకేతీకరించు / సంకేత సంఖ్య / కాంటర్ వికర్ణ పద్ధతి / వికర్ణీకరణ / సమస్యా తగ్గింపు / ష్రోడర్–బెర్న్‌స్టైన్
basis: Inspected witnesses support mathematical exposition, pairs and proof register but do not attest these advanced names. The selected wording is descriptive; Cantor and Schröder–Bernstein are explicit source eponyms. Each construction is fixed by its adjacent formula or proof.

source_term: arithmetization / embedding / commutative ring / ordered ring / ordered field
telugu: అంకగణితీకరణ / అంతఃస్థాపన / వినిమయ వలయం / క్రమిత వలయం / క్రమిత క్షేత్రం
basis: Native pages attest integer/rational/real number and theorem-proof register, while ordered-pair/set pages support the construction idiom. They do not attest these advanced algebra headwords. The frozen definitions and eight displayed ring laws control every selected descriptive term; no witness is claimed to establish the quotient constructions.
uncertainty: Low for number classes; high nomenclatural for arithmetization and algebraic structures

source_term: upper bound / least upper bound / greatest lower bound / Completeness Property / Dedekind cut / initial segment / Cauchy sequence / limit
telugu: ఊర్ధ్వ అవధి / కనిష్ఠ ఊర్ధ్వ అవధి / గరిష్ఠ అధో అవధి / సంపూర్ణతా ధర్మం / డెడెకిండ్ కోత / ఆద్య ఖండం / కౌషీ క్రమం / పరిమితి
basis: The inspected Telugu canon supports real/rational number and proof exposition, plus set comparison, but does not attest the advanced completeness constructions. Dedekind and Cauchy are explicit source-eponym borrowings; every cut, bound and convergence sense is held to the adjacent frozen definition and formula.
uncertainty: High nomenclatural; formal meanings and inequalities fixed

source_term: Dedekind infinite / Dedekind algebra / f-closed / arithmetical induction / isomorphic
telugu: డెడెకిండ్ అనంతం / డెడెకిండ్ బీజగణితం / f-సంవృతం / అంకగణిత ఆగమనం / సమరూపం
basis: TE-P016 directly supplies native finite/infinite-set register, TE-P003 supplies broad induction and proof language, and TE-P014 supplies function-domain/range register. None attests the Dedekind constructions or isomorphism headword. Dedekind is retained as the explicit source eponym; each advanced sense is fixed by the adjacent self-map, closure, induction and structure-preservation formulas.
uncertainty: Low for broad infinite-set and induction register; high nomenclatural for the Dedekind, closure and isomorphism headwords
